name: inverse HS with a VuManChu green dot
falsifier: If the neckline break is real, price should not return through the right shoulder; a win rate under 25% would say the pattern adds nothing to the dot.

name: head and shoulders with a red dot
falsifier: Shorts in a three-year sample where most coins rose should struggle; if this only works in the second half it is a bear-market artefact, not a setup.

name: double bottom into a daily uptrend
falsifier: If the higher-timeframe filter matters, removing it should make the numbers worse; if it does not, the filter is decoration.

name: oversold dot with money flow already green
falsifier: Money flow tested alone has no predictive power at all; if this beats the same rule without the money-flow term, the value is in the combination, and if it does not, drop it.

name: oversold dot alone - the control
falsifier: This is the plain signal the bot already trades. Every other setup in this library has to beat it or it is adding complexity for nothing.

name: daily dot in a volatile market
falsifier: If the volatility gate does nothing, this will score the same as the ungated daily dot; a lower trade count with no better expectancy means the filter is only shrinking the sample.
